title: He Found a Grant That Feels Like a Cheat Code ($2.4M/Year)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Sponsor read for Bizee (LLC formation) inside the episode

stated_problem.quote: In my experience, it's very frustrating to have plenty of customers, but no way to fulfill them because you don't have enough help, right?
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Grant-funded online forklift technician trade school attached to a repair business
idea.one_liner: White-label a 55-hour online forklift technician course for ~$500, get licensed so state workforce grants pay $5-15k tuition per student, and hire the best graduates into the partner forklift repair business
idea.customer: career changers funded by state workforce grants; employers needing certified techs
idea.offer: online certification course plus optional hands-on ride-alongs
idea.revenue_model: tuition paid by government grant (~$7,500 per student) minus ~$500 course license

key_quotes.quote: Not just that, he found a government grant that will pay him $5,000 to $15,000 per student to join his trade school.
They're getting a free grant to come to our school, but they're also learning a trade that it's not that talked about.
So the fact that I know how to find curriculum, build curriculum, partner up with the right operator is a, is a, is a good win.

claims.quote: Um, we're going to charge about $7,500 and the course is 500. So we're going to make a margin of $7,000.
Anywhere between 15,000 low in 30,000 high in.
We still sell some to the general market because again, our technicians are coming out making 30 bucks an hour.

acquisition_channels.details: students funded via state training grants (WIOA/ETPL)

ideas.delivery: Online curriculum (ebook plus videos) and computer-based certification test; optional hands-on at repair shop and ride-alongs with technicians; school owner handles CRM/automation while operator teaches
ideas.other_uk_rules: No direct WIOA equivalent; UK funding via Adult Skills Fund/Skills Bootcamps requires ESFA/DfE register approval and Ofsted inspection; qualifications via Ofqual-regulated awarding bodies

idea.name: Online-only licensed trade school selling white-labeled courses
idea.one_liner: Hector's first trade school sold online certification courses for $12-15k (bought for ~$1,500) funded largely by grants, going online-only to cut staff and sell statewide

key_quotes.quote: So, um, the second year, I only did 1.4, but with a two-man show.
And where we're able to scale is we're able to sell to anyone in Texas versus just the Dallas Metroplex.

claims.quote: We did 2.4 million our first calendar year. But a lot of that came into expense.
What were your selling that course for? 12,000 to 15,000.
What was your profit both those two years? It's like 70% margins.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Public funding requires DfE/ESFA approval and Ofsted oversight

stated_problem.quote: I found out no one had sell scripts, no one had CRMs, no one had any kind of automations.
stated_problem.speaker: Hector

idea.name: Sales and operations consulting for trade schools
idea.one_liner: Install sales scripts, CRMs, drip campaigns and grant/licensing processes for trade schools (welding, flight attendant, marine) or help start new ones
idea.offer: sales process, CRM and automation setup; school launch help

key_quotes.quote: So I went on my own doing that and now I've helped over 50 schools, either fix them, start them all over the country.

claims.quote: So I went on my own doing that and now I've helped over 50 schools, either fix them, start them all over the country.

idea.name: Selling online IT certification courses direct before licensing
idea.one_liner: Sell $8-12k IT courses to the general public as a digital reseller, then become licensed and add grant-funded students

key_quotes.quote: He sells IT courses and for two years before he remat me, he just sold to the general public.

claims.quote: Now he's added an additional 50 to 60,000 a month.

idea.name: Electrical and HVAC trade school with employer contracts
idea.one_liner: Houston trade school for electrical and HVAC with corporate training contracts

key_quotes.quote: She has contracts with manufacturer, some companies where she trains their data entry technicians and she just does really well.

claims.quote: She does electrical in HVAC. She's doing about four or five million a year.

idea.name: Training courses for data center facility jobs
idea.one_liner: Idaho operator sells courses for facility maintenance, appliance repair and industrial cleaning roles at new data centers

key_quotes.quote: He literally only does courses for the people going into the data centers that they're building out there.

idea.name: Online certification courses for prison inmates
idea.one_liner: Partner with a prison program so inmates take proctored online trade certifications and leave with credentials

key_quotes.quote: As they come out, as they come out, because it's it's online, they're taking the tests on the computer as being proctor.
